note: The output field every agent must declare, and the format of the shared surface register agents write it to. scripts/build-agents.py renders both into agents/, commands/ and the agents page, and scripts/build-agents.py --check and scripts/check-skills.py fail if an agent lacks the field.

output_field.heading: Assumptions and open questions
output_field.rule: It is required. An explicit None. is allowed when there are none; leaving the section out is not.

register.format: JSON Lines: one JSON object per line, UTF-8, append-only. Never edit or delete a line; a change of state is a new line.

declare.purpose: An agent declares an assumption it made or a question it could not answer.

update.purpose: The coordinator or the human changes the state of an earlier entry.

impact.meaning: what goes wrong if the assumption or the recommended answer is wrong: low is cosmetic or easy to undo, medium is rework in one phase, high is a wrong product, security or data risk, or rework across phases.

urgency.meaning: how soon the human's view is needed: low can wait for the end of the cycle, medium is needed before later phases rely on it, high blocks the work.

meaning.surfaced: Put in front of the human.
meaning.answered: The human answered, or confirmed or rejected the assumption.
meaning.dismissed: Settled from the repo or the brief, with the reason in note.
meaning.duplicate: Same as the entry in ref.

statuses.rule: An entry is declared with status open. Its current status is the status of the latest update line whose ref is its id.
